title: To Seek a Newer World
titleZh: 寻找一个更美好的世界
subtitle: An open letter on World Labs, AMD, and the road to spatial intelligence.
subtitleZh: 一封关于 World Labs、AMD 与空间智能之路的公开信。
author: Fei-Fei Li
description: Fei-Fei Li on why World Labs is joining AMD, and what publishing Atlas says about the next decade of AI beyond language.
descriptionZh: 李飞飞讲述 World Labs 为何加入 AMD，以及 Atlas 的发布对超越语言的人工智能意味着什么。

chapters.title: To Seek a Newer World
chapters.titleZh: 寻找一个更美好的世界

paragraphs.en: World Labs is joining AMD. This is a huge moment for World Labs, our team, and for me, and I wanted to take a moment to share what this means and why I'm so excited for this next chapter.
paragraphs.zh: World Labs 正式加入 AMD。这对于 World Labs、我们的团队以及我个人来说，都是一个意义重大的时刻。我想借此机会分享这一决定意味着什么，以及为什么我对接下来的新篇章充满期待。

paragraphs.en: "Come, my friends, 'Tis not too late to seek a newer world." — Lord Tennyson, Ulysses
paragraphs.zh: 「来吧，我的朋友们，现在出发寻找一个更新的世界，还为时不晚。」——丁尼生，《尤利西斯》

paragraphs.en: A coming of age story.
paragraphs.zh: 一个成长的故事。

paragraphs.en: AI to me is both personal and civilizational.
paragraphs.zh: 对我而言，人工智能既关乎个人，也关乎整个文明。

paragraphs.en: I entered the field as a fresh graduate student in the year 2000, chasing my curiosity for solving the problem of visual intelligence for machines and the brain. I didn't know it then, but these were the first steps of a career that has been, to my amazement, at the center of AI's coming of age. The early work from my lab called ImageNet helped usher in the age of modern AI, along with neural network algorithms and their implementation on GPUs. Since then, I've spent my entire career pushing AI from largely an academic curiosity to become the most innovative and transformative technology of our era.
paragraphs.zh: 2000年，我以一名刚刚开始研究生涯的学生身份进入这个领域，怀着强烈的好奇心，探索机器与大脑的视觉智能问题。当时我并不知道，这些正是我职业生涯的起点，而令我惊讶的是，后来我的职业生涯竟然处于人工智能走向成熟的核心位置。我所在实验室早期开展的 ImageNet 项目，与神经网络算法及其在 GPU 上的实现一道，推动了现代人工智能时代的到来。从那以后，我将整个职业生涯投入其中，致力于推动人工智能从一项主要停留在学术研究领域的探索，发展成为我们这个时代最具创新性和变革性的技术。

paragraphs.en: Throughout this time, from my research in computer vision, deep learning, robotics and healthcare, to founding Google Cloud's AI unit as a chief scientist, to becoming the founding director of Stanford's Human-Centered AI institute, my work has always been guided by the desire to solve real world problems, hand in hand with humans for societal betterment. When generative AI began its transformation, and frontier AI research at scale moved from academia to industry, I knew the path with the deepest and broadest potential for positive impact would be creating a startup to tackle the most audacious technical problems.
paragraphs.zh: 在这段漫长的历程中，无论是我在计算机视觉、深度学习、机器人技术和医疗健康领域的研究，还是后来以首席科学家的身份创立 Google Cloud 的 AI 部门，再到担任斯坦福大学以人为本人工智能研究所的创始主任，我的工作始终受到一个愿望的指引：与人类携手解决现实世界的问题，为社会进步贡献力量。当生成式人工智能开始改变世界，大规模前沿人工智能研究的重心也从学术界转向产业界时，我意识到，要产生最深远、最广泛的积极影响，最好的道路就是创办一家初创企业，挑战那些最艰巨的技术难题。

paragraphs.en: Together with my incredible co-founders Ben Mildenhall and Justin Johnson, two world-class AI researchers who have each moved the field in significant ways, I founded World Labs at the beginning of 2024. Our goal was to build a frontier lab focusing on some of the most important challenges in AI, which if solved, would dramatically improve AI's ability to tackle real world problems.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年初，我与两位出色的联合创始人 Ben Mildenhall 和 Justin Johnson 共同创立了 World Labs。他们都是世界一流的人工智能研究者，并且各自以重要的研究成果推动了这一领域的发展。我们的目标是建立一家前沿研究实验室，专注于人工智能领域一些最重要的挑战。一旦这些问题得到解决，人工智能解决现实世界问题的能力将得到显著提升。

paragraphs.en: The world is not just made up of words.
paragraphs.zh: 世界不仅仅由文字构成。

paragraphs.en: We built the company guided by the foundational belief that language alone isn't sufficient for model development. The universe isn't made up of words, it's made of real things. So many of the most important problems for AI to solve, from science to entertainment to robotics, require models to reason over the structure and behavior of the physical world. Tackling this problem domain requires a unique team with wide-ranging skills including data, computer vision, large model training, systems and even computer graphics. I feel very lucky to have built a founding team of researchers and engineers that contains world experts across these areas. Together, we set out to train new classes of foundation models to tackle the hardest problems in spatial intelligence, and we've made significant strides toward our goals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们创立这家公司，源于一个根本性的信念：仅仅依靠语言，并不足以完成模型的开发。宇宙不是由文字构成的，而是由真实存在的事物组成的。从科学研究、娱乐产业到机器人技术，人工智能需要解决的许多重要问题，都要求模型能够理解并推理物理世界的结构与行为。要解决这一领域的问题，需要一支具备多方面专业能力的独特团队，涵盖数据、计算机视觉、大模型训练、系统工程，甚至计算机图形学。我很幸运能够组建这样一支由研究人员和工程师组成的创始团队，其中汇集了这些领域的世界级专家。我们共同致力于训练新一代基础模型，以解决空间智能领域最困难的问题，并且已经朝着既定目标取得了重要进展。

paragraphs.en: Since our founding in 2024, World Labs has built leading AI spatial intelligence capabilities for everything from creative work to design. We built the world's leading model training team for images, video and spatial reconstruction. And, with the acquisition of SceniX, we're building towards an industry-leading capability for robotics simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 自2024年成立以来，World Labs 已经建立了领先的人工智能空间智能能力，应用范围涵盖创意工作与设计等多个领域。我们组建了一支在图像、视频和空间重建模型训练方面处于世界领先水平的团队。此外，通过收购 SceniX，我们正在构建行业领先的机器人仿真能力。

paragraphs.en: Recently we released Atlas, a first-of-its-kind omni model architecture that solves a key outstanding problem in spatial intelligence: new camera view prediction. Like LLMs can predict the next token from a line of text, Atlas, trained from scratch, can predict the next view from an input of 2D images, outperforming state-of-the-art results even by specialized models. It has essentially solved a long-standing problem in computer vision called sparse reconstruction, by combining generative models with multiview geometry. This has direct and far-reaching consequences: from design and engineering to science and robotics.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，我们发布了 Atlas。这是一种开创性的全能模型架构，解决了空间智能领域一个长期存在的关键问题：新视角预测。就像大型语言模型能够根据一段文本预测下一个词元一样，Atlas 是一个从零开始训练的模型，能够根据输入的二维图像预测新的相机视角，其表现甚至超过了专门模型所取得的最先进成果。通过将生成模型与多视图几何技术相结合，它实际上解决了计算机视觉领域一个长期存在的问题——稀疏重建。这项技术将产生直接而深远的影响，应用范围从设计、工程延伸到科学研究和机器人技术。

paragraphs.en: We've seen incredible interest in Atlas across many domains: RL environments for robotics; scene generation for therapy and entertainment; and real-world reconstruction for real estate, design and construction, and so much more to come.
paragraphs.zh: Atlas 已经在多个领域引起了极大的关注，包括为机器人提供强化学习环境、为治疗和娱乐生成场景，以及为房地产、设计和建筑行业重建真实世界场景。未来还将出现更多应用。

paragraphs.en: Following our North Star to AMD.
paragraphs.zh: 追随我们的北极星，迈向 AMD。

paragraphs.en: The research and technical breakthroughs we achieved at World Labs in such a short amount of time have only fueled our ambition and given us a clear vision for the potential for AI to solve spatial and physical world problems. Now that we have tangible proof of the possibilities, we want to do everything we can to accelerate the future.
paragraphs.zh: World Labs 在如此短的时间内取得的研究成果和技术突破，不仅进一步激发了我们的雄心，也让我们更加清晰地看到了人工智能解决空间与物理世界问题的巨大潜力。如今，我们已经拥有了切实可见的成果，证明这些可能性能够成为现实。接下来，我们希望尽一切努力加速未来的到来。

paragraphs.en: To do this requires scaling our efforts, widening our reach, and getting closer to the hardware. Without having a focused hardware effort, AI is hobbled in efficiency. And scale. And for our purposes, remains trapped in the digital world.
paragraphs.zh: 要实现这一目标，我们需要扩大投入、拓展影响范围，并进一步贴近硬件。如果没有针对硬件的持续投入，人工智能的发展就会受到效率和规模的限制。而对于我们的目标而言，它也将始终被困在数字世界之中。

paragraphs.en: Which brings me to AMD. We've partnered with AMD since our earliest days. AMD's CEO, Dr. Lisa Su, was an early investor and believer in our mission, and we shared a belief that AI could propel society toward a better future. She has also been a great friend to me as we each journey through the world of technology.
paragraphs.zh: 这就让我想到了 AMD。从 World Labs 创立之初，我们就与 AMD 建立了合作关系。AMD 首席执行官苏姿丰博士是我们的早期投资者，也是我们使命的坚定支持者。我们都相信，人工智能能够推动社会迈向更加美好的未来。在各自探索科技世界的过程中，她也一直是我的好朋友。

paragraphs.en: We began a deep technical partnership last year starting with model training and inference optimization on AMD GPUs. We've seen up close how Lisa is boldly leading AMD as a major player in the hardware ecosystem with incredible momentum. As our teams worked together, we realized what a natural fit it would be to bring together our AI ecosystem of software and hardware, foundation models and applications.
paragraphs.zh: 去年，我们开始建立深入的技术合作关系，首先围绕 AMD GPU 展开模型训练和推理优化。我们近距离见证了苏姿丰如何以大胆而坚定的领导力，推动 AMD 在硬件生态系统中成为一股重要力量，并展现出强劲的发展势头。随着双方团队不断深入合作，我们逐渐意识到，将软件与硬件、基础模型与应用结合起来，构建一个完整的人工智能生态系统，是多么自然且契合的选择。

paragraphs.en: Just like I knew it was time to do a startup to jumpstart the work of creating foundation models beyond LLMs and achieve the most impact in AI, it's again very clear that the right path for myself and World Labs is to continue our mission as a part of AMD. Together we're committed to keep pushing the frontier of AI to solve real problems, and doing so openly with the community and the entire ecosystem. We're unwavering in our mission, and even more excited to continue building a world-leading frontier research organization that is durable for the decades ahead. And we are committed to providing the best open models and platforms for running AI end to end from hardware to software to models to the data platforms needed to fuel it all.
paragraphs.zh: 正如当初我意识到应该创办一家初创企业，以推动超越大型语言模型的新一代基础模型研发，并在人工智能领域创造最大影响一样，如今我再次清晰地认识到，对我和 World Labs 而言，正确的道路就是作为 AMD 的一部分继续我们的使命。我们将携手不断推动人工智能的技术前沿，解决现实世界中的问题，并以开放的方式与开发者社区及整个生态系统合作。我们的使命始终坚定不移，而我们也更加期待继续建设一家世界领先、能够在未来数十年持续发展的前沿研究机构。我们还将致力于提供最优秀的开放模型和平台，构建从硬件、软件、模型到支撑整个系统的数据平台在内的端到端人工智能运行体系。

paragraphs.en: Solving real problems, for human betterment.
paragraphs.zh: 解决现实问题，促进人类福祉。

paragraphs.en: We're extremely thrilled to be part of a shared journey towards the future we want to build together; where powerful AI platforms and systems are developed and deployed to help solve the most fundamental problems that humanity faces: from drug discovery, to unleashing human creativity; from transforming learning to unlocking the next generation of robotics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们非常高兴能够参与这场共同创造未来的旅程。在这个未来中，强大的人工智能平台和系统将得到开发与部署，帮助解决人类面临的根本性问题：从药物研发到释放人类创造力，从变革学习方式到开启新一代机器人技术的发展。

paragraphs.en: And I can't be more excited to join as an Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist, working directly with Lisa and her team. My career has led up to this moment - to continue growing and running a frontier research team, within a leading AI company, as a scientist and a technology leader. With this expanded platform and opportunity, I feel a deep sense of humility, gratitude and hopefulness that we will build a future we believe in, guided by the same North Star that has always inspired me to build technology in service of humanity. I am beyond excited for the future and grateful for the opportunity for World Labs and AMD to build it together.
paragraphs.zh: 我无比期待以执行副总裁兼首席科学家的身份加入 AMD，直接与苏姿丰及其团队合作。我的整个职业生涯似乎都在为这一刻做准备：在一家领先的人工智能公司中，以科学家和技术领导者的身份，继续发展并领导一支前沿研究团队。拥有这样一个更广阔的平台和新的机遇，我内心充满谦逊、感激与希望。我相信，我们将共同创造一个值得我们为之奋斗的未来，并继续追随那颗始终指引着我的北极星——让技术服务于人类。我对未来充满期待，也由衷感谢 World Labs 与 AMD 能够携手创造这一未来。
